newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares fall in lower turnover.

text.p: 1030 GMT - Polish shares fell in lower turnover after a one-session rise but buying was stronger after price fixing. * The main market's WIG index fell 180 points, or 1.1 percent, to 16,244.2, the WIG 20 fell 1.2 percent to 1,600 and the parallel market's WIRR fell 0.8 percent to 3,778.1. * Turnover fell 13.5 percent to 152.6 million zlotys on all three markets as 62 issues fell, 22 rose and 14 were flat. Buy orders for 18 stocks and sell offers for six were unmatched. * Most active Lentex rose 4.7 percent in an 11.5- million-zloty turnover. NFI units rose 5.9 percent in 41.4-million-zloty trade. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
